newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains higher in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains higher in thin trading.

text.p: UK cash grain prices were around one to 1.50 stg up on Thursday with new crop supported by weather concerns.
"Weather is the chief concern for new crop, but old crop isn't doing much," said one broker.
Brokers said the market looked good on paper, but despite the number of delivered trades, there was not much tonnages.
"People are just doing odd loads here and there," said another broker.
Fob values were up around one stg, but no business was reported owing to the May Day holiday in most of Europe.
On the home market milling wheat 11 percent protein in the west was trading at 113 stg for May while 113.50 stg was paid in the midlands.
Feed wheat in East Anglia was trading at 95.50 stg for May and 99.75 stg for Jul.
On the south coast 96.50 stg was paid for May feed barley and 91 stg for Jul/Aug.
